questions.question: On a hundred chart, start at 30. Skip-count by 5s forward. What is the next number?
questions.explain: Adding 5 to 30 gives 35. A common trap is to add 2 or 10 instead of 5.

questions.question: Start at 44 on a hundred chart. Skip-count by 2s forward. What number comes next?
questions.explain: Adding 2 to 44 gives 46. Be careful not to add 1 or 4 by mistake.

questions.question: On a hundred chart, start at 70. Skip-count by 10s backward. What number comes next?
questions.explain: Going back 10 from 70 lands on 60. The trick is to go down, not up.

questions.question: Start at 25 on a hundred chart. Skip-count by 5s forward. What number comes next?
questions.explain: Adding 5 to 25 gives 30. Watch out for adding 2 or going backward by 5.

questions.question: Maya counts the stairs by 2s: 2, 4, 6, 8. What number does she say next?
questions.explain: Adding 2 to 8 gives 10. It is easy to add 1 or 4 by accident.

questions.question: Tom lines up buttons and counts them by 5s from 15: 15, 20, 25. What is the next button number?
questions.explain: Adding 5 to 25 gives 30. A common slip is to add 2 or jump to 35.

questions.question: Lily is on a bus. The stops go by 10s and she is at stop 50. She wants to go back. What stop does she name next?
questions.explain: Going back 10 from 50 lands on 40. The trap is to count forward to 60.

questions.question: On a hundred chart, start at 82. Count backward by 10s. What number comes next?
questions.explain: Taking away 10 from 82 gives 72. Be sure to go down, not up to 92.

questions.question: Sam skip-counts by 5s from 40: 40, 45, 50, 55, 60. What number comes right after 60?
questions.explain: Adding 5 to 60 gives 65. A common error is to add 10 and land on 70.

questions.question: You are skip-counting by 2s: 94, 96, 98, ___. What number comes next?
questions.explain: Adding 2 to 98 gives 100. Many kids say 99 because they get stuck right at the ten boundary.

questions.question: You start at 25 on a hundred chart and skip-count forward by 10s three times. What number do you land on?
questions.explain: Three jumps of 10 from 25 take you to 35, then 45, then 55. The trap is to stop after two jumps.

questions.question: Ben counts by 5s from 30: 30, 35, 40, 46, 50. What did he do wrong?
options: He went back by 5 one time
He jumped over a ten once
questions.explain: From 40 he jumped to 46, which is adding 6, not 5. The rest of the list is correct.
